title: fix(platform-objects): decide the lifecycle panel and the email-template sample per leaf — the whole remainder of #19403
body:
Part of #19403

Clause-②: no

Round 10 of #19403, and it takes the **whole remainder**: every leaf in
`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`
that still echoed its `en` source in any locale.

## The remainder this round took — re-measured on base `236cec19a`

| family | `en` leaves | `zh-CN` | `ja-JP` | `es-ES` |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `object.fields.lifecycle.storage` | 8 | 0 | 8 | 8 |
| `object.fields.lifecycle.archive` | 8 | 0 | 8 | 8 |
| `object.fields.lifecycle.ttl` | 6 | 0 | 6 | 6 |
| `object.fields.lifecycle.retention` | 4 | 0 | 4 | 4 |
| `object.fields.lifecycle.class` | 2 | 0 | 2 | 2 |
| `object.fields.lifecycle.reclaim` | 2 | 0 | 2 | 2 |
| `object.fields.lifecycle` (`label` + `helpText`) | 2 | 0 | 2 | 2 |
| `email_template.fields.variables.helpText` | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| **total** | **33** | **0** | **33** | **33** |

33 `en` leaves x 2 locales = **66 locale-leaves**. Every count is this round's own
reading, taken before a word was written, and it reproduces the dispatch table exactly.

### Census, before and after — with the control moving the other way

| reading | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `en` string leaves / `.label` leaves | 893 / 538 | 893 / 538 |
| POSITIVE CONTROL, `.label` genuinely translated (`zh-CN`) | 538 | 538 |
| POSITIVE CONTROL, `.label` genuinely translated (`ja-JP`) | 522 | **538** |
| POSITIVE CONTROL, `.label` genuinely translated (`es-ES`) | 522 | **538** |
| per-locale `.label` echoes | 0 / 16 / 16 | **0 / 0 / 0** |
| every string leaf echoing, per locale | 0 / 33 / 33 | **0 / 0 / 0** |
| the card's headline predicate (echoes in ALL THREE) | 0 | 0 |

Echoes down 33 in each of two locales while the control rises 16 in each, same
population, same run: a discrimination, not a parser matching everything.

## The remainder this round LEAVES — 0, and it is 0 for BOTH predicates

This card has been bitten twice by the difference, so both are stated:

- **all-three predicate** (a leaf echoing in `zh-CN` AND `ja-JP` AND `es-ES`): **0**.
  It also read 0 *before* this round, over 33 leaves a Japanese author was reading
  in English. That zero carried no information.
- **per-locale predicate** (a leaf echoing in at least one locale): **0**, and this
  is the one that had something to say.

Per locale and per family: `zh-CN` **0**, `ja-JP` **0**, `es-ES` **0**; every family
in the table above reads **0 / 0 / 0**. The new ledger asserts both readings on the
live tree, and proves they are *different questions* on a synthetic catalog where
the all-three predicate returns 0 while the per-locale one returns 1 — so the
property holds whatever the tree contains.

## The judgement, which is the whole card

An echo is not automatically a defect, so all 66 are decided per leaf with the
verdict, the per-locale reason and the `en` source they were judged against, in
`object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`. Every verdict came out
`translate`; the reasons record what each rendering was derived FROM.

**`zh-CN`'s answers were used as EVIDENCE, not as a translation.** They prove the
two other locales were unauthored fills and they settle what each leaf *means*;
the Japanese and Spanish words come from each locale's own authored twins, and
every row says which of the two it leaned on. Three rows record a deliberate
**departure from `zh-CN`**, with the reason:

- `lifecycle.storage.label` — `zh-CN` expands it to 存储策略; an exact authored twin
  for the bare word sits in this same panel's section heading
  (`object.sections.advanced.description` = ストレージ / almacenamiento), and
  expanding would leave the child row `storage.strategy` holding its parent's word.
- `lifecycle.class.helpText` — `zh-CN` replaces "rows" with 数据; the schema statement
  is about rows specifically and both target locales have an authored word for it.
- `lifecycle.archive.after.label` — `zh-CN` writes 归档时点 (a point in time); the
  schema types the value as a duration literal, so both locales name an AGE and share
  a head noun with `retention.maxAge`, which ADR-0057 requires it to EQUAL.

### One schema key, one rendering — what was copied, and where nothing existed

**22 of the 33 rows copy an authored twin**, asserted per locale against the live
catalogs (56 locale assertions) so the two positions can only ever move together.
The sharpest ones:

| row | authored twin | ja-JP | es-ES |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `lifecycle.archive.to.label` | `object.fields.datasource.label` | アーカイブ先**データソース** | **Fuente de datos** de archivado |
| `lifecycle.ttl.field.label` | `object.fields.fields.summaryOperations.field.label` | タイムスタンプ**フィールド** | **Campo** de marca temporal |
| `lifecycle.archive.keep.label` | `lifecycle.retention.label`, this ledger's own row | アーカイブ**保持期間** | **Retención** en archivado |
| `email_template.variables.helpText` | `email_template.fields.fromOverride.helpText` | **例: **`[{ … }]` | **Ejemplo: **`[{ … }]` |

**The other 11 rows say NO TWIN EXISTS rather than leaning on one.** Probed and
stated: `shard`, `telemetry`, `cold store`, `driver` and the disk-space sense of
`space` have zero authored renderings in either catalog, in either locale. Two of
those rows also record a near twin that was looked up and **refused**: Japanese
領域 is spent on the layout-region sense in this catalog
(`page.sections.layout.description`, `app.fields.areas.label`), so reusing it for
disk space would collide two concepts on one word.

One refusal is asserted in the suite so nobody leans on it later:
`sys_oauth_resource.fields.access_token_ttl.label` ("Access Token TTL") is
byte-identical in all three locales and reads like a standing decision to keep
`TTL` verbatim. It is **an unauthored fill in every locale, `zh-CN` included** — it
carries a provenance row in all three companions. The `TTL` decision rests on
`zh-CN`'s own authored answers and on round 7's landed machine-token treatment.

### Machine tokens kept verbatim, with a predicate that can say NO

19 tokens x 3 locales = **57 assertions**: `ADR-0057`, `record`, `audit`, `TTL`,
`created_at`, `expires_at`, `retention.maxAge`, `h/d/w/y`, `"30d"`, `"1d"`, `"7y"`,
`SQLite`, `DROP`, `O(1)` and the multiplication sign. The guard is a Unicode
word-boundary predicate, and the suite proves it can fail on these very strings.

**Round 9's recorded limit is now executable rather than prose.** The suite asserts
all four halves: a substring guard LIES on kana (`キャンセル` contains `セル`); this
predicate does not make that mistake; it pays with an UNDER-REACH (a genuine
standalone `セル` inside running Japanese, `このセルを編集`, is MISSED); and it only
sees a kana token that happens to be delimited. Sound and incomplete on kana — and
the suite also asserts that every token this ledger guards is Latin, a digit-unit
literal or a dotted path, so the limit does not bite here.

## The phantom-translation trap, asserted three ways

`objectForm` declares **no label on any of the sixteen lifecycle fields** (asserted,
all sixteen), so every `en` label here is `humanizeFieldPath` of the path — and one
is WRONG English: `lifecycle.ttl` humanizes to `"Ttl"`, whose correct English is the
initialism `"TTL"` that the form's own helpText and `LifecycleSchema`'s own TSDoc
both spell.

Correcting it would differ in bytes, satisfy the echo predicate in all three locales,
drop this card's census by a leaf and tell a Japanese author nothing. **It is not done
here and it discharges nothing.** The suite asserts the two English spellings differ,
that no rendering is either of them, and that the initialism survives as a token in
all three. It is written up in full in the Acceptance notes below. Round 8's
`Api Enabled` is the same producer and is still unfiled; this is its second instance.

## ADR-0057 was read at the live schema before a word was rendered

Five `it` blocks assert the claims the renderings rest on, each with its refusal leg:
`LifecycleClassSchema`'s five members (so `record` and `audit` are values an author
types, not words); §3.1 (a `record` class with a policy is refused) and §3.5 (a
non-`record` class with none is refused); `archive.after` must EQUAL `retention.maxAge`
(a mismatch is refused, the aligned pair parses); `LIFECYCLE_DURATION_REGEX` accepts
`30d`/`1d`/`7y` and refuses `30 days`, `30 天` and `30 días`; and storage is a COUNT
plus a GRANULARITY (`shards` min 2 refused at 1, `unit` enum refused at `quarter`,
`strategy` literal refused at `merge`).

## The instrument — populations DERIVED, never hand-listed

Two populations, two shape predicates:

1. **The lifecycle root is found by SCHEMA SHAPE.** `LifecycleSchema.shape` has six
   keys; the population is the one form composite whose DIRECT children are exactly
   those six. It follows a rename of the form field, grows when ADR-0057 grows, and
   can be wrong in a way a `startsWith('lifecycle')` walk never could. 32 leaves.
2. **The email rows are found by WIDGET** — `widget: 'json'` on `emailTemplateForm`,
   which reaches exactly two fields and four leaves.

**Controls.** OUTWARD: 94+ leaves of these two forms are excluded, five object paths
and three email paths asserted by name, and nothing excluded echoes anywhere.
INWARD: **3 of the 4 email-json leaves are NOT decided here and come back
NON-ECHOING in the same walk** — and one of those three is the exact structural twin
the decided row copies from. One leaf of a matched pair authored by a translator and
the other left as a byte copy: one leaf cannot be a decision and a fill at once.
DARK: fed the `en` catalog, the derived predicate flags every leaf of both populations.

**Three-leg pin**, carried from rounds 8 and 9: every row is held equal to the live
bundle, to the `en` source, AND to the form declaration that manufactures it (a
`helpText` to the form's own text, a `label` to the form declaring NONE).

## Round 8's deferral is DISCHARGED, and its bound TIGHTENED in the same act

`DEFERRED_SUBTREE = 'lifecycle'` with `RECORDED_DEFERRAL = 32` is **not deleted** —
the shape stays, because it is the dark control that made this population visible.
The 32 leaves moved out of the deferral into decided rows, `withinRecorded(0)` holds,
and round 9's two legs (`oldBound` unfalsifiable, shrink-only) are kept exactly as
they were.

**Tightened, not weakened:** with the deferral empty, the `inDeferral` skip in round
8's ratchet would let a NEW lifecycle echo through unnoticed, and `<= 32` over a true
value of 0 can no longer fail. Two lines now pin the exact reading beside the
shrink-only bound — the hole round 10 created by discharging the deferral, closed by
round 10. Ablation A1 reds them on the live tree.

## Two landed assertions this diff falsified — repaired in place, declared, none weakened

`report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts` (round 9) drew the POSITIVE half of its
provenance discrimination from the `metadataForms.` slice, and survived only because
`ja-JP` and `es-ES` still carried this round's 33 leaves. Emptying that slice made
`toBeGreaterThan(0)` false in two of the three locales.

The repair is **round 9's own precedent applied to round 9's own file**: draw the
positive sample from a population this card does not touch. The `objects.` slice
still carries hundreds of echoing leaves in every locale, so the composer now shows a
real positive AND a real negative in **all three** locales, where before it managed
it in two. The contract assertion is untouched — what moved is the SAMPLE DRAW, not
the claim. Ablation A2 reds it.

## Regeneration — `pnpm i18n:extract`, never by hand

Values were authored by hand (the documented seam for translated-locale strings);
the structure was regenerated with `pnpm i18n:extract`.

**Idempotence control, taken first:** a no-op `pnpm i18n:extract` on the untouched
base rewrote all 11 files and left `git status --porcelain` **empty over the whole
tree**. Every later diff is therefore attributable to the edits.

**No keys added, none removed**, proved on full flattened key sets over all four
bundles of both catalogs:

| reading | result |
|:--|:--|
| key set before / after | 9832 / 9832 lines, `diff` exit 0, **0 delta** |
| skeleton summary, all four locales | 2458 of 2533 — objects 1565, metadataForms 893, unchanged |
| NEGATIVE CONTROL, one key ADDED | equality reads **false**, delta 1 |
| NEGATIVE CONTROL, one key REMOVED | equality reads **false**, delta 1 |

## Second witness — the `metadataForms.`-prefixed companions, as SET EQUALITY

The provenance tables key under a `metadataForms.` prefix the bundles do not carry
(asserted), and hold an entry exactly while a leaf is still a byte copy of the source.

| locale | rows before | rows after | dropped | added | `metadataForms.` rows remaining |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `zh-CN` | 362 | 362 | 0 | 0 | **0** |
| `ja-JP` | 416 | **383** | **33** | **0** | **0** |
| `es-ES` | 425 | **392** | **33** | **0** | **0** |

Set equality against "exactly my N leaves" reads **true** in all three, every dropped
key carries the prefix, and the **perturbed-expectation control reads false** in both
directions (+1 and -1).

**One disclosure:** for `zh-CN` the expected-drop set is empty, so the `-1` perturbation
is a no-op and reads `true`. That is recorded as a vacuous leg, not counted as a
control; the `+1` direction still fires for `zh-CN`, and both directions fire for the
two locales that moved.

## Ablations — 6, each proved on disk, 18 assertions reddened

Mutation proved by anchor count plus blob hash; restore proved by blob hash **and** a
whole-tree `git status --porcelain`, which read clean after every one.

| # | mutation | red assertions |
|:--|:--|--:|
| A1 | revert `ja-JP` `lifecycle.reclaim.label` to its `en` source | **4** |
| A2 | re-add one `metadataForms.` row to `ja-JP`'s provenance table | **3** |
| A3 | reword the authored twin `object.fields.datasource.label` in `es-ES` | **1** |
| A4 | strip the `TTL` token from `ja-JP` `lifecycle.ttl.label` | **2** |
| A5 | declare a label on the `ttl` composite in `objectForm` (spec, rebuilt) | **2** |
| A6 | revert `zh-CN` `lifecycle.archive.label` to its `en` source | **6** |

A1 reds round 8's newly tightened bound on the live tree, which the old `<= 32` never
could. A2 reds three assertions across three different ledgers. A3 reds the copy
assertion with the exact message `es-ES object.fields.lifecycle.archive.to.label no
longer contains its twin object.fields.datasource.label`. A6 reds the sibling-evidence
leg and five others.

**A5 crosses a package boundary**, so it carries the build discipline: `@objectstack/spec`
resolves through its `exports` to `dist` and `packages/platform-objects` declares no
vitest alias for it. Mutate, `turbo run build --force --filter=@objectstack/spec`,
`ablation-dist-preflight packages/spec 'TTL__ABLATION__'` (hits in
`dist/browser/data/index.js` and others), then the suite. The marker did **not**
pre-exist in `dist` (checked before mutating). The restore leg rebuilt and ran the
preflight with `--absent`: *"marker absent from all 216 built files"* and *"working
tree clean against HEAD"*. No ablation was re-run until something landed and no
mutation was left on disk.

Two families exited **3** on the pre-merge sweep — `pnpm check:i18n` and

## Changeset — `patch`, and the diff really publishes

Probed against the built `files[]` set (`dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`), 67
files, 26.5 MB. **Round 9's escape reading replicates and extends**: the same build
spells the same characters two different ways.

| probe | spelling found in `dist` |
|:--|:--|
| U+30C7 (`デ`), U+5BB9 (`容`) | UPPER-CASE `\uXXXX` only — raw ABSENT |
| U+00F3 (`ó`) | **raw AND an UPPER-CASE `\xNN` escape** — two spellings, one build |
| whole `ja-JP` label `データライフサイクル` | UPPER-CASE `\uXXXX` |
| whole `es-ES` label `Ciclo de vida de los datos` | raw |
| NEGATIVE CONTROL, a string not in the package | false raw AND false escaped |

Every probe was built **from the character itself** (`codePointAt` then padded hex in
both cases and both widths), never typed by hand — a hand-typed raw probe reads a
FALSE ZERO for the Japanese strings here.

## Merge with `origin/main`

Merged immediately before the final push. `origin/main` moved from `236cec19a` to
`5c5b67fc4` (one commit, `#19595`), and **nothing it brought touches this region** —
`git diff --name-only` over the two refs returns no path under
`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/` or `packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts`.

Two-legged proof: base `236cec19a` **!=** `5c5b67fc4` (TRUE), and
`git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD` exits **0**, with a control leg on the
known ancestor `236cec19a` also exiting 0. The merge was clean, left no `os-regen`
deferral, and because it moved `packages/spec` the spec was rebuilt and
`check:generated` re-run (15/15 up to date) before anything else was believed.

## Acceptance notes

**1. `lifecycle.ttl` ships the wrong English — class (a), reachable today, and this
round could not file it.** Written out in full so a taker needs nothing else.

- **Producer.** `objectForm` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts`) declares no
  `label` on the `lifecycle.ttl` composite. `walkFormField`
  (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`, the `pushEntry` for
  `metadataForms.TYPE.fields.PATH.label`) therefore emits
  `humanizeFieldPath('lifecycle.ttl')`, which lower-cases everything after the first
  letter of the path leaf and yields `"Ttl"`.
- **Reproduction.** `humanizeFieldPath('lifecycle.ttl') === 'Ttl'`, and the shipped
  `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` carries `object.fields["lifecycle.ttl"].label ===
  "Ttl"`. The same file's `helpText` one line down reads "Per-row TTL expiry" and
  `LifecycleSchema`'s TSDoc spells `TTL` too, so the panel disagrees with itself on
  screen. Correct English: `"TTL"`.
- **Warning one, for whoever fixes it.** Correcting the English satisfies the echo
  predicate in every locale and drops this card's census by a leaf **while translating
  nothing**. It must not be counted as discharging a translation row — round 8 recorded
  the identical shape on `enable.apiEnabled` (`"Api Enabled"` / `"API Enabled"`), which
  is the same producer and still unfiled.
- **Warning two, for whoever picks the fix site.** The fix belongs in `objectForm`
  (`label: 'TTL'` on that composite), **not** in `humanizeFieldPath`. Teaching the
  humanizer an initialism list would silently change every other humanized label across
  all nine packages' bundles and would re-fill `en` leaves translators have already
  answered against the old spelling.
- **Dedupe words:** `humanizeFieldPath initialism` · `Ttl label wrong English` ·
  `objectForm declares no label lifecycle` · `Api Enabled humanize` ·
  `metadata form label capitalisation`.

**2. `*.objects.generated.ts` carries its own echoing population** — 362 / 383 / 392
echoing against 1203 / 1182 / 1173 translated. Re-measured here and unchanged. It has
no taker (**承接者:无**), which is why it is written down rather than assumed to be
someone's, and it is out of this card's stated population.

**3. `zh-CN` renders `lifecycle.storage.label` and `lifecycle.storage.strategy.helpText`
with the same string** (存储策略), so in Chinese the composite and its child tooltip
read identically. Noted, not filed: it is a landed decision of an earlier hand on a
leaf this round does not own, both strings are authored, and nothing is an echo. The
`ja-JP` and `es-ES` renderings keep parent and child distinguishable, as the English does.

**4. The generated-bundle merge hazard** — `git check-attr merge` reads `unspecified`
for these paths, so two branches adding keys merge clean with one side silently lost.
Re-measured, not acted on: the card body already rules it an `AGENTS.md` decision.

## Route

Draft, and it stays draft. `Part of #19403`, not a closing keyword: whether the card
closes is a reading the PM seat takes at the landing, against the trunk, with the
census. Nothing is armed and auto-merge is not set.
